title: Non-Adjacent Selection

story.briefing: Draining two neighbouring cells at once collapses the bank. Take the most charge you can without ever taking from two cells side by side.
story.success: Charge drawn at maximum, and the bank holds.

description: Given an array of cell charges, choose a set of cells with no two adjacent, maximising the total charge taken. Return that total. All charges are non-negative, and an empty array returns 0.
hints: For each cell there are two possibilities: take it, which rules out its neighbour, or skip it. The best answer up to a cell depends only on the best answers just before it.
You do not need to know which cells were chosen — only the two running totals: the best including the current cell, and the best excluding it.
Track two values as you sweep. The new "including" is the old "excluding" plus this charge; the new "excluding" is the larger of the two old values. Return the larger at the end.
